title: More vessels, more harmony: why the vessels can hold opposites that the lights cannot

lectures.id: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3
68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3
69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3
70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

overview:
After chapter 30's stress on the light, chapter 31 gives the vessels an advantage: more *hiskalelus*. A light of *chesed* cannot bear a light of *gevura*, yet it can shine in a vessel of *gevura*, so the vessel is what holds opposites. A loving parent can be strict; a spy acts nice to stab the enemy in the back; a heart can be angry at one it loves. In the body, a procedure on the foot can heal the eye, while the light of the heart will not help an old man's sight. Each of the six days has its own *midda* and still includes the others, and a sentence carried out always mixes *chesed* and *din*.

Then a contradiction: the inner vessels change with intention, while an angel, the lion's face and each day keep one job. The answer is two kinds of *hiskalelus*: changing *kavanos* from the inner light, and true opposites at once from the *makif*, as in the miracle of the sea. The *makif*'s line of measure both divides and connects, so the more specialized the parts, the more they need each other, like an assembly line. "So you should love your fellow Jew."

terms.gloss: harmony: literally fixing up; here the vessels working together, which comes from many vessels
inclusion: things interrelating, each including and connecting to the other, even to its opposite
netzach, hod and yesod: the outer part of the vessel, which makes the harmony between the vessels
connectors: a generic term for tendons, ligaments, veins, arteries and nerves
each day with its work: each day of creation had its own midda and its own job
a ruling for action: the sentence actually carried out, which must mix chesed and din, unlike the bare verdict
the Name of MaH on the inside: the Kav, which makes the vessels batel to the light; the source of hiskalelus in the lights
the outer side of the vessels: the letters, the deed, the angels; each keeps one job, yet it can hold two opposites in actual fact
encompassing light: the limiting power from which the outer vessels come
the line of measure in the makif: it divides everything and connects everything; the source of the limiting vessels
the man of Tikun: made of many divisions that let everything come together
the simple matter, which comes before the form; in it man came first

sections.title: The vessels' advantage: more hiskalelus, and that is the Tikun
sections.summary: The vessels have an advantage over the lights: they interrelate more. That interrelating is the harmony of *Tikun*, which comes from many vessels, and it is made by the outermost part of the vessel.

phrases.he: (לא) והנה יש יתרון מעלה בבחינת הכלים מבחינת האורות, ממה שיש בחינת ההתכללות בכלים יותר מבאורות,
phrases.en: The vessels have an advantage over the lights in this, that the vessels have more *hiskalelus*: they interrelate more than the *oros*.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שזהו עיקר בחינת התיקון
phrases.en: this is the main idea of *Tikun* (harmony).

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כידוע דעיקר בחינת התיקון הוא בא מריבוי הכלים כו'
phrases.en: as is known, that the main *Tikun* comes from many vessels.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ודוקא על ידי בחינת חיצוניות הכלי, שהוא בחינת נה''י כו'
phrases.en: And this harmony in between the vessels is made specifically by the external vessel, which is the *Nehi* of the vessel.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Chapter 31. Chapter 30 explained the inner, middle and outer vessels of the brain, heart and liver, and that the light is still the main thing, which the vessels exist to express. Now: the vessels' advantage over the light, more *hiskalelus* (inclusion). They interrelate more than the lights do.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **The vessels have an advantage over the lights in this, that the vessels have more hiskalelus**: they interrelate more. This is *Tikun*: literally fixing up, here harmony.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: *Tikun* comes from many vessels. In *Tohu* (Chaos) there was much light and few vessels, which broke; in *Tikun*, little light and many vessels. The harmony between them comes from the external vessel, its *Nehi* (*netzach*, *hod* and *yesod*).

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

sections.title: The proof: the light of chesed can shine in the vessel of gevura
sections.summary: Light of *chesed* can shine in a vessel of *gevura* and the reverse. It cannot be the light that allows this, since a light cannot bear its opposite light; it must be the vessel, which can hold a thing and its opposite.

phrases.he: וראיה לזה ממה שמצינו בכמה מקומות דאור החסד יוכל להאיר בכלי הגבורה
phrases.en: And the proof for this is that we find in many places that the light of *chesed* can shine into the vessel of *gevura*,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ואור הגבורה בכלי החסד
phrases.en: and the light of *gevura* can shine into the vessel of *chesed*.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ואם כן,
phrases.en: And if so,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: מה שיחליף האור להאיר בכלי היפוכו,
phrases.en: this, that the light can shine into the opposite vessel,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: אם היה זה מצד עצמו
phrases.en: if this was because of the light itself, that the light is able to handle the other vessel,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: למה לא יוכלל ויחובר באור היפוכו המנגדו?
phrases.en: why does the light not connect with its opposite light?

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כמו אור מדת החסד
phrases.en: for example the light of *chesed*, a person that wants to be kind,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שלא יסבול אור מדת הדין כלל וכלל
phrases.en: they would not tolerate the light of *din* at all.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: The proof: **the light of chesed** (kindness) **can shine into the vessel of gevura** (severity), and the reverse. If the light did this by itself, why can it not join its opposite light?

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Someone who wants to be kind and loves a person dearly **would not tolerate the light of din** (judgement) **at all**, a desire to harm him.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: אלא מוכרח לומר
phrases.en: rather we must say

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שזהו מצד בחינת הכלי,
phrases.en: the ability of the light to go into an opposite vessel comes because of the vessel, not because of the light:

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שיכול לסבול אור היפוכה המנגדה
phrases.en: that the vessel can tolerate the opposite light that opposes it.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כי יש בכלים דוקא בחינת וענין ההתכללות מדבר והיפוכו,
phrases.en: because specifically the vessels have this quality of having two opposites at once,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: מה שאין כן באורות כו'
phrases.en: which is not the case with the lights.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: So it must come from the vessel, not from the light. The light of *chesed* cannot handle its opposite; the vessel can: **the vessel can tolerate the opposite light that opposes it**.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **Specifically the vessels have this quality of having two opposites at once.** The lights, pure and altruistic, cannot handle such a duality, which is not necessarily hypocrisy.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

sections.title: The body: heal the foot and the eye sees, but the light of the heart will not help the brain
sections.summary: The *Tikun* in a person comes from his body, the vessel: each organ includes the others, so one can be healed through another. The lights of the brain and the heart do not combine like that; only strengthening the vessel of the heart strengthens the vessel of the brain.

phrases.he: וזהו עיקר התיקון בבחינת האדם מצד גופו
phrases.en: And this is the main thing of harmony, the *Tikun* that we find in a person because of his body, which is like the vessel.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שאנו רואים בחוש
phrases.en: like we see tangibly,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: טבעי אברי האדם,
phrases.en: the nature of the organs of a person,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שכל אחד יש בו התכללות מזולתו,
phrases.en: that each organ is made up of and connects to every other organ,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: עד שיכולים להשלים חסרון א' על ידי רפואת אבר זולתו
phrases.en: until the body is so interconnected and interrelated that you can heal one part of the body through healing another part of the body.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: This is the main *Tikun* in a person, **because of his body, which is like the vessel**: each organ is made up of, and connects to, every other.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: The hand connects to the foot. The brain and the nerves, the heart and the veins, the food the liver digests, the lymphatic system: each goes out into the whole body, **until the body is so interconnected and interrelated that you can heal one part of the body through healing another part of the body.**

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: A shot in the arm may be meant for the kidney or the leg: whatever goes into one part of the body reaches the whole body.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.title: The shot in the arm

phrases.he: כמו לקלקול הראות בעין
phrases.en: for example, if somebody has difficulty seeing, they have a problem with their eyes, their vision,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ירפאו לכח הגידין שברגל,
phrases.en: it's possible to heal the different *gidin*, the different connectors in their foot, and that could heal the eye,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שיש בהן בהתכללות מגידין שבעין
phrases.en: because the *gidin* in the foot are connected and relate to the *gidin* in the eye.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: So for poor vision one can heal the *gidin* (connectors) in the foot, **because the gidin in the foot are connected and relate to the gidin in the eye**. *Gid* means anything that connects: tendons, ligaments, veins, arteries, nerves.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: This sounds a little like reflexology: heal the tendons of the foot and the eye is healed. But Rabbi Walters once saw a place where it seems to mean the blood: for poor vision, let blood from the foot. For the explanation here the procedure does not matter: the point is that a procedure on the foot can heal something in the head.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

sensitivity.reason: Names reflexology and bloodletting from the foot as ways to heal the eye; a reader might take them as treatments.
sensitivity.publishable: For the explanation here the procedure does not matter: the point is that a procedure on the foot can heal something in the head.
sensitivity.judgmentNote: Health: he names reflexology and bloodletting from the foot as ways to heal poor vision, which a reader could try. The teaching needs only that something done to the foot can heal the head; weigh whether his passing remedies can be printed.

phrases.he: אבל לא ירפאו לאור וחיות שנחלש במוח עד שנחלש בראות מצד הזקנה וכהאי גוונא,
phrases.en: But let's say a person, because they're getting old, starts to lose the vitality in their brain, their soul starts to retract from the brain, and so it weakens their sight;

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: על ידי חיזוק כח ואור חיות המדות שבלב,
phrases.en: it would not help to strengthen the light of the emotions in the heart, to bring in more light also into the eye;

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: אף על פי שהמוח ולב כלולים זה עם זה
phrases.en: even though the brain and the heart are made up of each other and interrelate to each other.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: But say a person gets old and his soul, tired of involving itself with his senses, retracts from the brain: he starts to go blind with nothing physically wrong. Since the problem is only in the light, not the vessel, strengthening the light of the emotions in the heart brings no more light into the eye.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: So if a person is getting old and has trouble seeing just because of the light, "it won't help to throw them a party."

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: This holds **even though the brain and the heart are made up of each other and interrelate to each other**: that is the vessels, not the light in them.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: רק מצד חיזוק כלי הלב יחזקו לכלי המוח ויאיר כח השכל בראות יותר כו'
phrases.en: Only if you heal the vessel of the heart, then it will strengthen the vessel of the brain, and that will cause the light of the *sechel* to shine into seeing more.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: מפני שאין לאור השכל עם אור המדות חיבור והתכללות כל כך, כמו שיש חיבור והתכללות של כלי הלב עם כלי המוח
phrases.en: Because there's not so much of a connection and interrelationship between the light of the *sechel*, the light of the intellect, with the light of the emotions, like there is a connection and interrelationship between the vessel of the heart with the vessel of the brain.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **Only if you heal the vessel of the heart** is the vessel of the brain strengthened, and the light of the *sechel* (intellect) shines more into the sight. The physical vessel can be treated; the light cannot.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: The reason: there is **not so much of a connection and interrelationship** between the light of the intellect and the light of the emotions as between the vessel of the heart and the vessel of the brain.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: וכן כלי העין עם כלי החוטם וכלי האוזן וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: And the same thing: the eye is connected with the nose, and the ears, and the like; all the different parts of the body are connected.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ולזה הטעם הנה דוקא מצד בחינת הכלי יוכל להאיר בה אור המנגדה כו'
phrases.en: And that's why specifically the vessel is able to hold the opposite light,

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ודי למבין.

blocks.text: Likewise the eye connects with the nose and the ears. **That's why specifically the vessel is able to hold the opposite light**: a vessel of *chesed* has something of *gevura* and connects to it, and a vessel of *gevura* has something of *chesed*.

audio.lecture: 67 - Chap- 31-1 Hiskalelus and Tikun in Keilim.mp3

sections.title: In thought, speech and deed, and even in the heart, a light can shine in its opposite
sections.summary: As lights, *chesed* and *gevura* oppose each other. Once they come into vessels (thought, speech and action, and even the vessel of the heart itself), a person can act strict out of love or nice out of hatred, and be angry at someone he loves.

phrases.he: ויובן זה יותר במה שאנו רואים במדות חסד וגבורה שהן הפכיים מנגדיים ממש כו'
phrases.en: Now we'll understand this better from looking at the two emotions of *chesed* and *gevura*, kindness and severity, which are opposite emotions, and they also oppose each other.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: אך כאשר באין המדות בכלי,
phrases.en: But when these emotions come into a vessel,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כמו למחשבה ולדבור ומעשה בפועל ממש,
phrases.en: to actually think about it, or to say it, or to do it,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: יוכל אור החסד להאיר במחשבה ודבור ומעשה היפוכו ממש
phrases.en: then the light of *chesed* can shine into an opposite *machshava*, *dibur*, *maaseh*.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שהרי יכול לחשוב ולדבר ולעשות נגד מה שבלבו
phrases.en: For a person is able to think, speak and do the opposite of what's in his heart.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: This is clearer from *chesed* and *gevura*, **which are opposite emotions, and they also oppose each other**: one feeling *chesed* feels no *gevura*. **But when these emotions come into a vessel**, **the light of chesed can shine into an opposite machshava, dibur, maaseh** (thought, speech, action).

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Expressed, *chesed* can act strict: a loving parent who could never want to hurt the child is strict for his benefit, which is really *chesed*, the light of *chesed* in a vessel of *gevura*. The reverse is the spy who acts nice "in order to stab the enemy in the back."

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.title: The strict parent and the friendly spy

blocks.text: **For a person is able to think, speak and do the opposite of what's in his heart.**

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: וגם לכעוס בלב על אוהבו בלבו,
phrases.en: your heart can get angry at somebody that you really love,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ולרחם בלבו על שונאו כו'
phrases.en: and you can feel mercy in your heart for somebody that you really hate.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שהלב מוכן להיות כלי למה שהוא היפוכו כו',
phrases.en: Because the heart is ready to be a vessel for its opposite,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: לפי שבכלים יש התכללות דבר והיפוכו יותר מבאורות
phrases.en: because the vessels have this ability to have two opposites more than the lights do.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: (דמה שבגילה יש רעדה וברוגז יש רחמים, וכן להיפך, ברעדה גילה וברחמים רוגז, הכל מצד הכלי דוקא כו')
phrases.en: Because this, that it's possible in joy to have fear, and in anger to have mercy, and also the opposite, that in fear there should be joy and in mercy there should be anger, all comes because of the vessel, specifically.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Further: even before thought, speech and action, which are *levushim* (garments), in the vessel of the heart itself **your heart can get angry at somebody that you really love**, and feel mercy for someone you hate. In the light you feel one way; in the vessel, either way.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **The heart is ready to be a vessel for its opposite.** While your heart loves someone, if he does something that provokes anger, the vessel can react with anger, though you do not want to be angry at him. In the vessel the emotions are *murkav* (composite), not a simple *midda* (attribute): **the vessels have this ability to have two opposites more than the lights do.**

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Joy with fear, anger with mercy, and the reverse, fear with joy and mercy with anger: this **all comes because of the vessel, specifically**. The light could not hold such opposites.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

sections.title: The six days: each day its own attribute, yet each includes the others
sections.summary: Each day of creation had its own *midda*, *chesed* on the first and *gevura* on the second, as the *Zohar* says that each day does its own work. Yet every day included the others, because a day is the light come into a vessel, a whole cycle of opposite things.

phrases.he: וכך אנו מוצאים בששת ימי המעשה,
phrases.en: And this is like we see in the six days of creation,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שביום א' הוא בחינת חסד - יהי אור, וביום הב' בחינת גבורה - יהי רקיע כו',
phrases.en: that we see that each day had its own *midda*. The first day was the *midda* of *chesed*: that's when light was created, which is a thing of *chesed*; and the second day is a *midda* of *gevura*, which is when the firmament was created that separated, which is a thing of *gevura*, division.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב בזהר
phrases.en: Like it says in the *Zohar*,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: דכל יומא בעבידתיה כו'
phrases.en: that each day had its own job.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ועם כל זה
phrases.en: Nevertheless,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: בכל יום יש התכללות מיום זולתו דוקא
phrases.en: each day was related to and connected to the other day, specifically,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כידוע
phrases.en: as is known.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: לפי שכאשר בא האור בכלי שנקרא יום,
phrases.en: Because when the light comes into the vessel, which that's the idea of a day,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: אז יש התכללות דבר והיפוכו דוקא
phrases.en: in the vessel it has all types of opposite things that happen within the same sphere.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **This is like we see in the six days of creation**: each day had its own *midda*. The first, *chesed*, made light; the second, *gevura*, made the firmament that separates. As the *Zohar* says, *kol yoma b'avidtei*: **each day had its own job**.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Yet **each day was related to and connected to the other day**. The first day's light was limited and physical, a thing of *gevura*; the second day's firmament divided the waters so that there should be people, a *chesed*. Each day touched every *midda*, but its main job was one.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **When the light comes into the vessel, which that's the idea of a day**, there is *hiskalelus* of opposites. G-d called the light day: the light was already there and was then joined to a day, the time it shines, revealed in the world. And a day is a whole cycle of changes and events: the vessel holds opposite things in the same sphere.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

sections.title: In actual deed, kindness and judgement must mix: the verdict and the sentence
sections.summary: Once a thing comes to actual giving, *chesed* cannot be without *din* or *din* without *chesed*, like a sentence that is carried out. In theory, without a vessel, each can stay pure; so the main *hiskalelus* is in the outer vessel, where things come to action.

phrases.he: להיות שכאשר בא הדבר לידי השפעה בפועל ממש,
phrases.en: Because when you come to do something in actuality,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: אי אפשר שלא יוכלל בחסד מבחינת דין ובדין מבחינת החסד
phrases.en: it's impossible that you should not have the inclusion of a *chesed* in the *din*, and the *din* in the *chesed*.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: מה שאין כן כשהאור והשפע עדיין בלא כלי כו'
phrases.en: On the other hand, when the light is still without a vessel,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Why can the vessel hold opposites? **When you come to do something in actuality, it's impossible that you should not have the inclusion of a chesed in the din, and the din in the chesed**: no punishment is only *din*, and every kindness has a limit.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **When the light is still without a vessel**, it is theory, and in theory you can want only *chesed* or only *din*. Infinite love, once it comes *l'maaseh* (to action), is limited, with some *din* in it; and for infinite hate no revenge is great enough: "it's always too nice."

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כמו פסק דין למעשה דוקא
שבהכרח יוכלל חסד בדין ודין בחסד
מה שאין כן כשאינו למעשה כו'
ונמצא שמצד בחינת חיצוניות הכלי, שהוא למעשה,
phrases.en: So it comes out that in the external vessel, that's where it comes *l'maaseh*,

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שם הוא עיקר בחינת ההתכללות כו' ודי למבין:
phrases.en: that's where there's the main *hiskalelus*.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: It is like a *psak din l'maaseh* (a ruling for action), where *chesed* is necessarily included in *din*. The verdict can find a man totally guilty; the sentence, what is actually done with him, say twenty years in jail, is not total *din*: that is *chesed*.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.title: The verdict and the sentence

blocks.text: **So it comes out that in the external vessel**, where it comes *l'maaseh*, **there's the main hiskalelus**, more than in the internal vessel: what is not yet *l'maaseh* needs less.

audio.lecture: 68 - Chap- 31-2 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

sections.title: The contradiction: hiskalelus is in the inner vessels, and the outer ones never change
sections.summary: Seemingly the opposite is true: a light can shine in its opposite vessel only through the vessel's *bittul*, which comes from the *Shem MaH* inside, the *Kav*; so the inner vessels have *hiskalelus*, while the outer vessels, from which the angels and the six days come, each keep one job.

phrases.he: אך
phrases.en: However,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: הנה לכאורה יש סתירה לכל זה
phrases.en: seemingly, there is a contradiction to all of this.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שהרי באמת,
phrases.en: For the truth is,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: מה שהאור יוכל להאיר בכלי היפוכו,
phrases.en: this, that the light is able to shine into its opposite vessel,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: הוא מצד בחינת הביטול של הכלי לגבי האור
phrases.en: that's because the vessel is totally *batel* to the *or*.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: והוא על ידי בחינת שם מ''ה מלגאו,
phrases.en: And this *bittul* of the *kelim* comes from the idea of this *Shem MaH*, the name of *MaH* on the inside;

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שרש בחינת ההתכללות באורות, דוקא
phrases.en: that's the source of *hiskalelus* in the lights,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: מצד הארת הקו כו'
phrases.en: because of the *Kav* shining into it.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **Seemingly, there is a contradiction to all of this.** The main *hiskalelus* was said to be in the *kelim* (vessels), in their *chitzoniyus* (outer side); but it seems to be in their *pnimiyus* (inner side).

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **For the truth is**, the light can shine into its opposite vessel **because the vessel is totally batel** (nullified) **to the or**: it does whatever the light wants. This *bittul* comes from the *Shem MaH* on the inside, the *Kav* (the ray of light) controlling the *kelim* from within their *Chabad*: **the source of hiskalelus in the lights**, as explained in chapter 15.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ולזה הטעם, דוקא בפנימיות הכלים יש התכללות
phrases.en: And for this reason *davka* the *pnimiyus* of the *kelim* have *hiskalelus*,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: (וכמו הכונה שבמעשה המצות
phrases.en: like, for example, the *kavana* to an action, the intention in performance of the *mitzvos*,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שמתכלל ב' הפכים כו'
phrases.en: that in the level of *kavana* you can have two opposites coming together.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: והיינו כמו עצמות וגידים כו' מה שאין כן גוף המעשה)
phrases.en: And this is like the bones and the connectors, like the nerves and the veins, as opposed to the actual action itself, which is from the *basar*, from the flesh, the muscle.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ולא בחיצוניות
phrases.en: And we do not have this *hiskalelus* in the *chitzoniyus*.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **For this reason davka** (specifically) **the pnimiyus of the kelim have hiskalelus**: in the *kavana* (intention) of *mitzvos* two opposites can meet. That is like **the bones and the connectors**, the nerves and veins, as against the deed itself, from the *basar*, the flesh.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Give the poor man *tzedaka* and you did the *mitzva*. Give it for personal gain and the *kavana* is bad, yet it is still a *mitzva*, even not *lishma* (for its own sake), because the deed is there. The *kavana* can be the opposite; the deed does not change.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.title: Tzedaka for personal gain

blocks.text: Is a knife good or bad? It depends who holds it and what for. That comes from the inner vessel, the purpose and the person controlling it; the knife itself stays the same knife. **And we do not have this hiskalelus in the chitzoniyus.**

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.title: The knife

phrases.he: שהרי אין מלאך א' עושה ב' שליחות
phrases.en: because one *malach* cannot do two jobs,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: הפכים
phrases.en: in other words, two opposite jobs.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: מפני שכל שליחות השפע בא מחיצוניות הכלים דוקא,
phrases.en: because they come from the *chitzoniyus hakelim*,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שמביא השפע לחוץ
phrases.en: that they bring the *shefa* to the outside,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כמו חיצוניות הכלי דאותיות וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: like the external vessel of the letters, the thought, speech and action, and the like, that bring out the *sechel* and the *middos* and everything in the *maaseh* to the outside.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: For **one malach** (angel) **cannot do two jobs**, **two opposite jobs**. He can do two jobs in the same field: Refael could heal Avraham and save Lot, because both are saving, helping.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: The *malachim* come from the *chitzoniyus hakelim* (the outer side of the vessels), which does not change and has no *hiskalelus*: they **bring the shefa** (flow of influence) **to the outside**, as thought, speech and action bring the *sechel* and *middos* out into the deed.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ולכך
phrases.en: And therefore,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: פני אריה להימין כו',
phrases.en: that's why the face of the lion is on the right side, etc.:

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: לא ישנו את תפקידם
phrases.en: they will not change their posts.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ולא יתחברו
phrases.en: And they will not join up together

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: להחליף מעשיהם מזה לזה כו'
phrases.en: to switch jobs.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ולכך כל יומא בעבידתיה דווקא כו'.
phrases.en: And therefore every day of creation had its own separate job without *hiskalelus*, because each one was from the *chitzoniyus hakli*; it was separate.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **That's why the face of the lion is on the right side**: **they will not change their posts**, **and they will not join up together to switch jobs.** The bull never offers to take over for the lion for a while: the lion is a predator, and the bull eats plants.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: So **every day of creation had its own separate job without hiskalelus**, being from the *chitzoniyus hakli*. The *chitzoniyus* seems to have no room for *hiskalelus*, and the *pnimiyus* does. He will show that both are true.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

sections.title: The answer: the inner vessels from the inner light, the outer vessels from the makif, the miracle
sections.summary: The inner vessel receives from the *or pnimi*, so when the lights are included in each other its *hiskalelus* is one of changing intentions. The outer vessel comes from the limiting power of the *makif*, so it can hold two opposites at once in actual fact, like a miracle: the sea that stood up while staying water, the Ark that took no space.

phrases.he: אך הענין הוא משום דפנימית הכלי הוא מקבל מבחינת אור פנימי המוגבל בכלי,
phrases.en: The inner part of the vessel receives from the internal light, meaning the light that becomes limited into the vessel according to its level.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: וכאשר יש התכללות באורות,
phrases.en: And when the lights have *hiskalelus* from the *Shem MaH*, in other words, when you're able to have different *kavanos* for what you're doing,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: ממילא יש התכללות בפנימית הכלים,
phrases.en: automatically the inner *kli* also has *hiskalelus*,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כמו התפעלות והשגות מיכאל וגבריאל כו'
phrases.en: like the understanding and the excitement of Michael and Gavriel.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: וחיצוניות הכלים
phrases.en: And the external vessels

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: מבחינת הכח המגביל שבבחינת מקיף
phrases.en: come from the power of limitation that just makes the limits, that's in a way of a *makif*.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **The inner part of the vessel receives from the internal light**, limited to its level. When the lights have *hiskalelus* from the *Shem MaH*, when you can have different *kavanos* (intentions) for what you do, **automatically the inner kli also has hiskalelus**, like the understanding and excitement of Michael and Gavriel.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **And the external vessels come from the power of limitation**, a *makif*: the *or makif* (encompassing light), not the *or pnimi* (inner light).

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: על כן יש בו ב' הפכים כאחד,
phrases.en: So therefore it can have two opposites at once,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: בחינת התכללות דבר והיפוכו דוקא
phrases.en: the combination of something and its opposite *davka*.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **So therefore it can have two opposites at once.** The inner vessels get *hiskalelus* from the *or pnimi*, the outer from the *or makif*. The first is a *ratzon murkav* (a composite will): you like this for one reason and that for another, so sometimes you are nice, sometimes mean, and sometimes you find the proper will.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Such a will, being *murkav*, changes (as explained about *ratzon murkav* and *ratzon pashut*), so you use the vessel in different ways: that is the *pnimiyus* of the *kli*. The *chitzoniyus*, from the *makif*, holds two opposites not in theory but in actuality: **the combination of something and its opposite davka.**

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כמו כל הנסים, שהם דוקא בבחינת חיצוניות הכלים בפועל ממש
phrases.en: Like all the miracles: the whole thing of a miracle is that it happens in the *chitzoniyus* of the *kli*.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כמו כל מקום שנעשה בו הנס,
phrases.en: For example, any place where a miracle happened,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: שהמקום הזה סובל דבר והיפוכו,
phrases.en: that this place, this space, tolerated contradictory things,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: מלמעלה מן הטבע בטבע כו'
phrases.en: higher than nature in nature.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: כהפיכת ים ליבשה כו',
phrases.en: Like transforming water to dry land,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא מקום הארון אינו מן המדה וכו',
phrases.en: or like it says, the place of the *Aron* wasn't counted in the size,

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר
phrases.en: as explained elsewhere.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: **The whole thing of a miracle is that it happens in the chitzoniyus of the kli**: the place **tolerated contradictory things**, **higher than nature in nature**.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: **Like transforming water to dry land.** The water stayed water, wanting to flow, yet stood as a wall, and the muddy ground became dry. It made no sense: the *pnimiyus* of the *kli*, the *sechel* of how water should act, did not agree. But "the actual water molecules, they are stupid": they do whatever G-d tells them. Only the science says they cannot stand.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text: Or **the place of the Aron** (the Ark) **wasn't counted in the size**. It was one and a half by two and a half *amos*, yet from each side of it to the wall was five *amos*, and wall to wall ten. It took up space and did not: higher than nature and nature at once.

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

blocks.text:
Back to the water: had G-d changed its nature to stand, it would only be above nature, standing on its own with no wind. Its nature stayed to flow, and it stood anyway: two opposites, higher than nature in nature.

So too the sea became dry land, walls and a floor like marble, "but it was all water still."

audio.lecture: 69 - Chap- 31-3 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim.mp3

sections.title: Division is the root of Tikun: the assembly line, and man made last and first
sections.summary: The *makif*'s *kav hamida* both divides and connects, so the *Tikun* comes from much division: the more specialized each part, the more it must work with the rest. That is the *Adam d'Tikun*, made last in form and first in matter, as the chair is made of wood that was there before anyone wanted to sit.

phrases.he: וגם משם הוא בא שרש בחינת ההתחלקות, כל אחד מובדל בפני עצמו
phrases.en: is also the source that makes the division that separates things

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: שהוא בא מצד בחינת קו המדה שבמקיף,
phrases.en: That comes from the *kav hamida*,

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: שהוא שרש הכלים המגבילים כו'
phrases.en: that's the source of the *kelim* that limit.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: The *makif*, source of the external vessels and of the power to hold two opposites, as in a miracle, **is also the source that makes the division that separates things**.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: **That comes from the kav hamida** (the line of measure), which divides and connects everything: because it makes the divisions, it can make the connections. "It makes the rules, it can break the rules." It is the *makif*, **the source of the kelim that limit.**

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: ולזה עיקר בחינת התיקון הוא בחינת ריבוי ההתחלקות דוקא
phrases.en: And this is why harmony comes from a lot of division:

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: שבזה דוקא יהיה ריבוי ההתכללות, דבר והיפוכו כאחד
phrases.en: from that, that's what allows to have many opposites together.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: **This is why harmony comes from a lot of division.** In the body every organ is very specialized, very different from the others; that lets them work together and makes them interdependent. **From that, that's what allows to have many opposites together.**

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: Many divisions bring *Tikun* like an assembly line: the more you specialize each worker, the more he needs everybody else. You could teach each of hundreds of workers to make a whole car. Or, without even telling them what you are making, you teach each one step: "Your job is to tighten this bolt. That's it." The conveyor belt brings the piece, you tighten it, and it moves on.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.title: The assembly line
blocks.outOfPlace: Told near the end of class 70, after the chair; placed under lines 50-51, the many divisions that bring about Tikun, which it explains.

blocks.text:
The more specialized the jobs, the more people it takes to finish a car, and they must work together, since none can do anything else.

So in the body, especially in people: each organ needs all the others; a brain, a heart or a liver cannot live alone. That is *hiskalelus* in a person: everything works together because everything is so divided.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Continues the assembly line from the end of class 70; placed with it under lines 50-51.

phrases.he: וזהו עיקר בחינת אדם דתיקון כו',
phrases.en: This is the main thing of the man of *Tikun*, that there's divisions that allows everything to come together.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: שעליו אמר אחור וקדם צרתני,
phrases.en: About man it says, "You made me last and first."

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: יצירה בגוף חומר דוקא כו'
קדם, בבחינת החומר הפשוט שקדם לצורה,
phrases.en: the actual matter of the body, the simple matter that it's made out of, which came before the form, that's first,

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: שהוא האור
phrases.en: which is the light.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: והוא בשרש הכלי
phrases.en: And that original simple matter was in the source of the *kelim*,

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: שקדם לאור
phrases.en: which is before the light.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: ואחור, בכלי החומר שאחר האור והצורה כו'

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: ודי למבין
וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר ביאור ענין זה באריכות

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

phrases.he: (ודי למבין):

blocks.text: This is the *Adam d'Tikun*, **the man of Tikun**, made of divisions that let everything come together, of whom **it says, "You made me last and first."**

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: *Kedem*, first, is **the simple matter that it's made out of, which came before the form**. The form, **which is the light**, came after; the matter is **in the source of the kelim**, **which is before the light**.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: **But we were made last as far as the form**, which comes after the light; this is explained elsewhere at length. The simple matter came first, from the *reshimu* (the impression left after the *tzimtzum*); the form comes through the *Kav*, as light, and the thickening of the light makes the *kli*. So the vessel's matter precedes the light, and its form, following the lowest level of the light, is last.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: To sit, you make a chair. Its form comes out of the lowest level of your desire to sit: you shape it to your body, to what is comfortable. But its material was there before you were born, before you ever wanted to sit; it just was not a chair yet. The form came last.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.title: The chair

blocks.text: So the chair comes *mamash* from the *achor* (the back, the last), from your *achorayim*: you make it to fit your *tachas* (behind).

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

sensitivity.reason: A bottom joke: the chair comes from the achor because it is made to fit your behind.
sensitivity.publishable: So the chair comes *mamash* from the *achor* (the back, the last): you make it to fit the one who sits on it.

blocks.text: So the *kelim*, not the lights, are the main source of *hiskalelus*: in their *pnimiyus* from the *or pnimi*, in their *chitzoniyus* from the *or makif*. *Kelim* are division, so more *kelim* make more *hiskalelus*.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: At first there was only *Adam HaRishon*, meant to do every job, and he messed up. So it became more divided: each soul has a specific *shoresh* (root), makeup and *shlichus* (mission), and we must work together like one big body. Specialization is efficient, but it needs more *achdus* (unity) to accomplish anything.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

blocks.text: So love your fellow Jew and work together with him. Alone you will tighten a bunch of bolts: "No car, just bolts." Connect with the others, and then you can do something.

audio.lecture: 70 - Chap- 31-4 Hiskalelus and Tikun in the Keilim (End).mp3

reviewQuestions.question: If a light of *chesed* can shine in a vessel of *gevura*, why must that come from the vessel and not from the light?
Why can a procedure on the foot help the eye, while strengthening the light of the heart will not help the failing sight of an old person?
How can a loving parent act strictly, and how can a heart be angry at someone it loves?
Why can the verdict be pure *din* while the sentence never is?
What do *tzedaka* given for personal gain and the knife show about the inner and outer vessels, and why does one angel not do two opposite jobs?
How was the splitting of the sea two opposites at once, and why does a miracle belong to the outer vessel?

notes.text: Phrases whose English comes from his explanation a few words after the reading, not from a rendering right after it (NOTES.md allows this): the middle of line 7 (67 w489-509), the end of line 25 (68 w1151-1167), line 48 (70 w47-64, from his sentence on the makif as the source of division) and the end of line 49 (70 w136-143). The middle of line 37 (69 w624-635) keeps only his rendering, not the explanation that follows it. Line 43 cites his second reading of it (69 w1238-1246), which is cleaner than the first (69 w1038-1050).

Read without translating, so Hebrew only: lines 28-30 (he explains them together in the verdict-and-sentence mashal), the end of line 52 (yetzira b'guf chomer davka), and v'dai l'mevin in lines 16 and 55.
Class 67 opens with a recap of chapter 30 (w0-131); it is placed under line 1 as the chapter's introduction.

"I once saw somewhere else where he says" (67 w980-1029): it is not clear whose words he means (the Mitteler Rebbe elsewhere, or a commentator); the block keeps it vague. Flagged health-or-legal for the bloodletting and reflexology.

The Ark (69 w1582-1662): he says the room was ten amos wall to wall with five amos on each side of the Ark. The Gemara's figure (Yoma 21a, Megilla 10b) is a room of twenty amos with ten on each side. The block keeps his numbers; a reviewer may want to correct them in the public edition.

Class 69 ends in the middle of the sea discussion and class 70 opens with the last words of line 47 ("as explained elsewhere", 70 w0-6), cited as that phrase's English and listed in omitted as reading.

Class 70's assembly line and its application to the body (w672-1075) are placed under lines 50-51 (Tikun from much division), with outOfPlace; the closing recap, Adam HaRishon and "love your fellow Jew" stay under the last passage.

Left unflagged as ordinary illustration: the spy who acts nice to stab the enemy in the back (68), "20 years in jail, that's chesed" (68), "the water molecules are stupid" (69), the ruling that tzedaka given for personal gain is still a mitzva (69), and the account of an old person's sight failing because the soul withdraws from the senses (67 w1095-1230): that is the text's own claim about light and vessel, put as a 'let's say', not advice. Flagged: the bloodletting/reflexology aside (health-or-legal) and the chair's tachas joke (crude).
Refael healing Avraham and saving Lot (69 w594-615) is given as he says it; the source (the Midrash on Bereishis 18-19) is not named in class.
